blocks.text: Day 3 · After breakfast, a shared half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the old centre of Rio, with its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings.
